# Saving throw against an effect — SRD 5.2.1

The same template, params and dice as `../saving-throw-vs-effect-srd-5.1/`. SRD 5.2.1 states
Restrained the same way (*Rules Glossary > Restrained [Condition]*), so the outcome is
identical: the pair keeps the lower die, `6 + 1 (Dexterity) = 7`, a failure against DC 13.

The derivation is in the 5.1 case's README.
